contentList.content: Purple Dragon Knight

The Purple Dragon Knights are paragons of valor and leadership who partner with amethyst dragons. Such knights aspire to protect the innocent and rally fellow adventurers to the causes of justice and freedom. These knights psionically bond with an amethyst dragon hatchling, irrevocably transforming both dragon and knight and allowing the dragon to grow in strength alongside its partner.
Amethyst Dragon Companion

Call forth a bonded amethyst dragon that can fly and reposition enemies with its <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_GravityBreath">breath attack</LSTag>. The dragon will grow and gain new abilities as you gain levels in this class.

You can revive your fallen dragon companion by expending the use of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SecondWind">Second Wind</LSTag> ability or taking a <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
Amethyst Dragon
Rend
Attack a target with your claws.
Stalwart Bond

Entity's Proficiency Bonus is equal to that of its bonded Knight. In addition, half of the Knight's Proficiency Bonus is added to any ability check or saving throw the entity makes.

The Knight's Intelligence modifier is applied to the entity's AC, spell save DC, attack rolls, and attack damage.
Your <LSTag Tooltip="Intelligence">Intelligence</LSTag> modifier is applied to the dragon's abilities and defenses.
Dodge

Until the start of your next turn, any <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">attack rolls</LSTag> made against you has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">disadvantage</LSTag>, and you make Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throws</LSTag> with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag>. You lose this benefit if you are either incapacitated or immobilized.
Flight: Hover
Hover in the air to avoid <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DIFFICULT_TERRAIN">difficult terrain</LSTag> and most surfaces.
Hovering
Suspended in the air.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> You must land to attack.
Gravity Breath
Breath Weapon
Unleash a localized shift in gravity that can push or pull creatures inside the affected area.
Amethyst dragons can breathe a cone of energy that shifts gravity.
Must land to attack.
Gravity Breath: Push
Push a target [1] away from you.
Gravity Breath: Pull
Pull a target [1] toward you.
Shared Second Wind

When you use your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SecondWind">Second Wind</LSTag> ability, your bonded dragon companion regains [1] plus [2] and one use of its <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_GravityBreath">Gravity Breath</LSTag>.
Regain hit points and one use of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_GravityBreath">Gravity Breath</LSTag>.
Dragon Mount

Your bonded dragon has grown to Medium size, and can carry you for brief distances.

Your dragon will stop hovering for the turn it carries you.
Improved Gravity Breath

Your bonded dragon's <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_GravityBreath">Gravity Breath</LSTag> can be used [1] times per day, increases to a [2] cone, and deals [3] to a target that fails its <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag>.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> Your dragon will stop hovering for the turn it carries you.
Flight: Carry Knight
Take to the sky, moving your bonded knight to a space within [1].
Must be bonded knight.
Must be Medium or smaller size.
Rallying Surge
Rallying Surge: Advance
Rallying Surge: Retreat

When you use your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ActionSurge">Action Surge</LSTag> ability, up to three allies can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to either attack or move.
Direct an ally within [1] to attack a nearby foe.
Direct an ally within [1] to move to a space near you. They will not provoke an <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">opportunity attack</LSTag>.
Has already been rallied.
Must have enemy in range.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> The ally must have an enemy in range of its active weapon or unarmed strike.
Make an attack with a weapon or unarmed strike against a target within range in response to a Purple Dragon Knight's <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ActionSurge">Action Surge</LSTag>.

Move to a new location in response to a Purple Dragon Knight's <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_ActionSurge">Action Surge</LSTag> without provoking an <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">opportunity attack</LSTag>.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> The ally must have an unobstructed path to you.
Must be closer to ally.
Change Shape
Magically alter your size and shape to ease overland travel.
Superior Mount

Your bonded dragon has grown to Large size and has increased speed. It can carry you for brief distances and attack while maintaining its ability to <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Hover_PurpleDragon">hover</LSTag>.
Your bonded dragon's <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_GravityBreath">Gravity Breath</LSTag> can be used [1] times per day.
Tandem Attack

As part of your attack action, command your bonded dragon to use its <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Rend_PurpleDragon">Rend</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_GravityBreath_2">Gravity Breath</LSTag>.
Tandem Attack: Rend
As part of your attack action, forego one attack to command your bonded dragon to use its <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Rend_PurpleDragon">Rend</LSTag> ability against an enemy within range.
On your turn, you can forego one or more of your attacks to command your bonded dragon to attack a nearby foe.
Not in melee range of dragon.
Tandem Attack: Gravity Breath

As part of your attack action, forego two attacks to command your bonded dragon to use its <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_GravityBreath_2">Gravity Breath</LSTag> ability against an enemy within range.
Not in breath range of dragon.
Enduring Commander
You and your bonded dragon have <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> to Force and Psychic damage.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> This will count as two attacks for the purpose of determining how many remaining attacks you can make as part of your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="ExtraAttack">extra attack</LSTag> ability.
